title: Otto 65W GaN Wall Charger USBC Port & Rectractable Cable Tan $21 + Delivery ($0 to Metro Areas/ C&C/ in-Store) @ Officeworks
body:
Deal: Otto 65W GaN Wall Charger USBC Port & Rectractable Cable Tan $21 + Delivery ($0 to Metro Areas/ C&C/ in-Store) @ Officeworks

[hopper] What happens when you plug the retractable usb c cable into the plugs usb c port when on?
[jestincredible] Data centres are going to start approaching you
[digitalspark] You find it difficult to explain it to fire brigade when they come home
[illusion99] What’s so difficult about saying I plugged the retractable usb c cable into the usb c port when on?
[Clear] Just tried it and my house isn't on fire
[WhatsThisThenSlaat] You sir become the receiver..and discover the Tesla coil in all its glory
[shmahoo] You become Ouroboros and unlock unlimited potential
[Che0063] Thanks OP, Got 2.
Would be great for carrying around/travelling due to the size.
Wonder if it supports PPS? Probably not but still worth it as a charger I guess
[etcode] Where are the details? Any idea if it supports PPS at 21 v?
[mjh2] I used one of the Otto "Wildskin" chargers from Dec '23 daily till it petered out a month or so ago, which was a shame as it was faultless till then…Officeworks gave me a full refund as I had the receipt which I thought was pretty good!
[bio] I'm still using one. Paid $5 from memory. No complaints so far.
[Brick50] Also got one as well, still working fine.. wish I bought a couple more
[JimmyF] Did you get it under this deal? https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/809555
[mjh2] No.
This one: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/821068
Why?
[JimmyF] LOL even worse….you took back a $7 charger after 2+ years of use….
I'm shocked it even had a warranty longer than 12 months. 3 years is impressive!
[mjh2] @JimmyF: As if you are giving someone a hard time for getting a refund for a faulty product on a bargain website?
Well yeah, the product in this deal is the same brand and has a 3 year warranty?
[Tacooo] Beware this thing is wide and blocks ports on either side. I cut the excess lip off mine (heh) and it barely fits now.
[andytheturtle] Dev: we already gave them two charging ports/options. Why they complaining about losing out on the blocked outlet?
/s
Thanks for pointing this out. This is really helpful to know!
[carrawa] You might only have two outlets in a room.
[jolt] If you have an ABN and set up a Business Account with Officeworks (for free) then the price drops to $19.95.
Thanks OP, I got 5 of them.
[iamprabhath] thanks .. first time i knew about this .. created the account and bought one .. thanks
